judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the footer image (img alt="Our Funders", 500x108) that shows two logos: the Government of Ireland / Rialtas na hEireann harp logo and the Pobal logo with 'government supporting communities'. claimTrue: the alternative does not describe something absent; 'Our Funders' is a category label for what the image shows, so the sentence as worded does not hold, though it points at a real gap. elementFails: the image is informative (it tells users who funds the organisation), and no visible text, caption or description on the page names the funders; the alternative omits the organisation names that are the image's whole content, so it is not an equivalent (1.1.1, G94/G95: logos' alternatives should carry the text they show). captureDiffers: the live page fetched now serves the same img, src and alt in the same footer, and the screenshot shows the logos with no 'Our Funders' heading beside them. Label: the claim, read in good faith as the rubric's example (an alternative said to describe something the image does not show when it leaves out most of what the image conveys), names the real failure, so true_positive.
